verdict.rationale: E2B's template docs say developers can define custom sandboxes by specifying the base image, environment variables, files to copy, build commands and a start command (e2b-docs-17). Templates are pre-built with running processes (e2b-docs-11), managed through the CLI (e2b-docs-9) and used to launch sandboxes via `e2b sandbox create <template>` (e2b-docs-36), and snapshots can also be saved as named templates (e2b-docs-40). missing for 10: explicit documentation of bringing an arbitrary existing or private-registry container image (only a configurable base image is mentioned), independent or hands-on corroboration of template builds.
